name_input: MASTURLAL CORDS AND ROPES PVT LTD
export_evidence: ImportKey (India customs, slug 'masturlal-cords-and-ropes-private-limited'): "2026-02-06 | MASTURLAL CORDS AND ROPES PRIVATE LIMITED | AMBER SUPER PAPER LTD | NYLON PAPER CARRIER ROPE , ARMOURBRAID 4LITE PA COATING 12MM DIA- | BANGALORE ACC INBLR4, India | DHAKA, Bangladesh | 56075090 | 9435461" — i.e. exporter = Masturlal, consignee Amber Super Paper Ltd (Dhaka, Bangladesh), HS 56075090, B/L 9435461, dated 2026-02-06. Second export row same page: "2026-01-30 | MASTURLAL CORDS AND ROPES PRIVATE LIMITED | FINE HYGIENIC PAPER COMPANY LTD | NOZZLES METSO MECHANICAL NOZZLE D25565- | BANGALORE ACC INBLR4, India | AMMAN, JORDAN | 84249000 | 9215514" (HS 84249000, B/L 9215514). Counter check: page header states "Total Shipments 345 Records detected", "Trading Partners 16", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-21"; the free view displayed only 5 shipment rows (3 import + 2 export) out of the claimed 345 — so the 345 figure is the site's counter, not rows actually seen. Only 2 export rows were visible; no full export ledger was accessible.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender, contract or annual-report split was retrieved. ImportKey shows only customs records (address "16/1, BANNERGHATTA ROAD, N/A"); volza.com, eximpedia.app and trademo.com returned HTTP 403 and the search backend was unavailable, so domestic supply evidence could not be checked. Not public in the sources reachable — recorded as null, not inferred.
note: Real export shipments are confirmed by dated customs records with B/L numbers, destination and HS code — the company is an actual exporter, not merely a claimant. Note the declared HS 560750 matches the Bangladesh rope shipment (56075090) but the Jordan shipment is HS 84249000 (nozzles), so the company ships a mixed product basket; the declared HS is consistent with the core cordage line and needs no correction. The claimed industry 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is not supported by any shipment line seen — cargo is cordage/braiding machinery/adhesive tape/nozzles, i.e. industrial textiles and machinery, not food or FMCG. Import side is also active (e.g. PURIZE FILTERS GMBH & CO.KG, HSIANG CHUAN MACHINERY, I-COATS N.V.), indicating a manufacturer_trader profile.
